name: stalker2-cfg-tools
description: VS Code tooling for STALKER 2 CFG files with SID navigation.

stalker2Cfg.enableIndexing.description: Enable workspace-wide CFG SID indexing for Go to Definition and Hover. Disable this for startup/crash diagnostics.

stalker2Cfg.vanillaReferencePath.description: Workspace-relative folder containing the extracted vanilla CFG reference files. Files below this folder are treated as Base/Vanilla and are used to resolve @BaseGame references and bpatch targets.

scripts.install-local: npm run compile && npm run package && code --install-extension stalker2-cfg-tools-${npm_package_version}.vsix --force
